ruleDefinitions.name: Linux Webshell Indicators
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious sub processes of web server processes

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\/httpd$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/lighttpd$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/nginx$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/apache2$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/node$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/caddy$")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/java.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*tomcat.*")) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/java.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*websphere.*"))) AND (process_path = RGX("\\/whoami$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ifconfig$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ip$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bin\\/uname$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bin\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bin\\/crontab$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hostname$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/iptables$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netstat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/pwd$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/route$"))
